title: Agentic AI framework finds misfit-dislocation structure in nickel grain boundaries
summary: GBClaw, an LLM-based agentic framework, ran simulations and mechanistic analysis of 14 asymmetric tilt grain boundaries in nickel. It identified previously unobserved widely spaced secondary grain-boundary misfit dislocations in simulated configurations and in experimental images, and sliding with them showed substantially different shear strength. This is a preprint based on atomistic simulation, and the role of the LLM versus researcher guidance is unclear.
